title: What a Godly Man Does When He Gets Cut Off in Traffic (It's Not About the Other Driver)
caption:
Somebody cuts you off. Before the horn even sounds, you've already written the whole speech in your head.

The road is one of the most honest places a man can be. Nobody's watching. Nobody from church is in the passenger seat. Whatever comes out of you there is what's actually in you.

Catch the speech. Give him the story you'd want someone to give you. Be hard on the man who left late, which is usually you. Pray for the guy in the silver Civic.

"Whoever is slow to anger is better than the mighty, and he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city." Proverbs 16:32

Send this to the brother you've watched lose it at a red light.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #selfcontrol #patience
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
